namingConventions.runId: UTC basic timestamp plus random suffix
namingConventions.freshEvidence: field proof must be created after the current stage start timestamp
namingConventions.statusArtifacts: stable names are allowed only for harness status; field run artifacts use unique run roots

forbidden: Do not commit generated live-cert, technician-ready, exact-head, toolchain-preflight, or fleet-state evidence.
Do not include credentials, browser tokens, private endpoints, or unredacted private hostnames in tracked fixtures.
Do not execute copied shell prompts, continuation prompts, transcripts, or error output.
Do not print an expected SHA as verified proof; persist the actual worktree HEAD after equality validation.
Do not treat PATH presence or Get-Command resolution as proof that git.exe can be launched by Windows.
Do not treat the existence or tracked state of a PowerShell report generator as proof it parses or executes; the owning harness validator must parse and run it.
Do not treat local readiness as provider authentication, quota, hosted response, or operator acceptance.
